_about: Maps src/ directories to the doc sections that describe them, and the doc's hardcoded test-count claims to the test paths that produce them. Consumed by scripts/doc-check.ts (CI, .github/workflows/doc-check.yml) and by the local pre-push hook (#172). Kept at repo root so both readers resolve the same file. Every directory under src/ must appear in `cascade`; an entry with no targets must say why in `undocumented`. A `section` must match exactly one heading in its doc, as a substring. Validated by test/scripts/doc-check.test.ts.

src/scoring.undocumented: Outcome scoring, turn attribution and lift comparison have no section of their own in README or SYSTEM-SPEC; neither doc mentions src/scoring. Give it one and add the targets here.

src/showcase.undocumented: The showcase template is undocumented in README and SYSTEM-SPEC; neither doc mentions src/showcase. Give it a section and add the target here.
